title: Path-specific agent instructions live in .github/instructions and are scoped by applyTo/excludeAgent frontmatter
answers: where do Copilot cloud agent instructions go?
how do I scope repository instructions to certain files or agents?
why does the code-review agent ignore my instruction file?
where are PR description rules for the cloud agent defined?
body:
Agent-specific repository instructions are files named `*.instructions.md` under `.github/instructions/` (example: `.github/instructions/cloud-agent.instructions.md`).
The YAML frontmatter controls scope: `applyTo` takes a glob (the added file uses `"**"`, so it applies to all paths).
`excludeAgent` names an agent to skip; the added file sets `excludeAgent: "code-review"`, so it applies to the cloud agent but not to code review.
The body holds the rules. The current file has one section, "Pull request descriptions", which requires descriptions to explain motivation and keep task references (issues, PRs, Actions run/job URLs, docs, upstream changes, measurements or logs) when the description is later updated.
When changing these rules, edit this file and keep the frontmatter scope intact; a change to `applyTo` or `excludeAgent` changes which agent sees the rules.
applies: Repository-level Copilot/agent instruction files under .github/instructions; does not cover general contributor docs or the PR template.
